leadText:
The following is a list of Pokémon currently owned by Goh. As his goal is to every that he meets on his way to catch , Goh owns a multitude of Pokémon species, most of which he usually keeps at the Cerise Laboratory. The Galar first partner Pokémon are the only ones that he permanently keeps in his party.

In This Could be the Start of Something Big!, Goh left all of his Pokémon, aside from his Galar first partner Pokémon, under Professor Cerise's care before departing from the Cerise Laboratory, though he still continues to catch new Pokémon.
